name: GPT-4o
description: OpenAI's flagship multimodal model supporting text, image, audio input and output in a unified architecture. Serves as the primary model powering ChatGPT and is available via API for developers.

name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
description: Anthropic's flagship language model offering strong performance across coding, reasoning, instruction-following, and multimodal understanding. Available via API and as the default model powering claude.ai.

name: Gemini 1.5 Pro
description: Google DeepMind's long-context multimodal model supporting text, images, audio, video, and code with a 1 million-token context window. Accessible through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.

name: DeepSeek-R1
description: Open-weight reasoning model from DeepSeek using reinforcement learning to achieve strong performance on mathematics, coding, and logical reasoning tasks. Weights released under the MIT License.

name: Llama 3.1
description: Meta AI's family of open-weight large language models available in 8B, 70B, and 405B parameter sizes with a 128K token context window. Supports multilingual tasks, reasoning, coding, and tool use.

name: Mistral Large
description: Mistral AI's flagship proprietary language model for enterprise use, offering strong multilingual reasoning, coding, and instruction-following performance. Accessible via the Mistral API and La Plateforme.

name: Qwen2.5
description: Alibaba's Qwen2.5 series of open-weight language models available from 0.5B to 72B parameters, with strong performance in coding (Qwen2.5-Coder), mathematics (Qwen2.5-Math), and multilingual instruction following.

name: FLUX.1 [schnell]
description: Fast text-to-image diffusion model from Black Forest Labs designed for local inference, generating high-quality images in 1–4 steps using Latent Adversarial Diffusion Distillation. Released under Apache 2.0 license.

name: Whisper
description: Open-source automatic speech recognition model from OpenAI trained on 680,000 hours of multilingual audio data. Supports transcription and translation in 99+ languages. Weights freely available for local use.

name: text-embedding-3-large
description: OpenAI's high-performance text embedding model producing dense vector representations for semantic search, RAG, and classification tasks. Outperforms ada-002 on MTEB benchmarks with configurable output dimensions.

name: Stable Diffusion 3.5
description: Stability AI's text-to-image diffusion model featuring improved prompt adherence, image quality, and typography generation. Available in Large (8B) and Medium (2.5B) variants with weights downloadable under a community license.

name: Phi-3
description: Microsoft Research's family of small language models (3.8B–14B parameters) designed for efficient local inference on resource-constrained hardware. Offers strong reasoning performance relative to model size.

name: Command R+
description: Cohere's enterprise-focused language model optimized for RAG pipelines, tool use, and multi-step agent workflows. Supports 10+ languages and excels at instruction following for business applications.

name: BGE-M3
description: Multi-functionality, multi-linguality, and multi-granularity text embedding model from BAAI. Supports dense retrieval, sparse retrieval, and multi-vector retrieval in 100+ languages. Open-source under MIT License.

name: Falcon 180B
description: Open-weight large language model from the Technology Innovation Institute with 180 billion parameters, trained on 3.5 trillion tokens of the RefinedWeb dataset. Supports text generation and completion tasks.

name: MusicGen
description: Open-source text-to-music and melody-conditioned music generation model from Meta AI AudioCraft. Generates high-quality stereo audio from text descriptions and optional melodic conditioning inputs.

name: OpenAI o1
description: OpenAI's frontier reasoning model designed to spend inference time thinking before producing answers. Uses reinforcement learning to execute long chain-of-thought reasoning across competitive math, coding, and scientific research benchmarks.

name: Gemma 2
description: Family of lightweight open-weight models (2.6B, 9B, and 27B parameters) from Google DeepMind built upon Gemini research. Features sliding-window attention and knowledge distillation for exceptional single-GPU efficiency.

name: Claude 3.5 Haiku
description: Anthropic's fastest language model in the Claude 3.5 family. Delivers coding, text analysis, and instruction-following performance matching prior flagship Claude 3 Opus at high inference speeds and low per-token operational cost.

name: DeepSeek-V3
description: Open-weight 671-billion parameter Mixture-of-Experts language model (activating 37B parameters per token) developed by DeepSeek. Features Multi-head Latent Attention and auxiliary-loss-free load balancing for cost-effective inference.

name: Llama 3.2
description: Meta's multimodal open-weight collection offering 11B and 90B vision-language models alongside 1B and 3B lightweight edge text models. Optimized for mobile, on-device computing, and visual document analysis across 128K context windows.

name: Codestral
description: Mistral AI's 22-billion parameter open-weight language model trained on 80+ programming languages. Features a 32K context window with fill-in-the-middle capabilities for IDE autocompletions and codebase refactoring.

name: Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM 2)
description: Meta FAIR's foundation model for real-time visual promptable object segmentation across both static images and dynamic video frames, tracking target object masks continuously through occlusions and camera perspective shifts.

name: DINOv2
description: Vision foundation model developed by Meta FAIR using self-supervised learning without text supervision. Produces universal visual features for monocular depth estimation, semantic segmentation, and image retrieval.

name: CLIP
description: OpenAI's foundational vision-language model trained on 400 million image-text pairs via contrastive learning. Maps images and text into a shared embedding space to enable zero-shot image classification and semantic multimodal search.

name: HunyuanVideo
description: Tencent's 13-billion parameter open-source video generation model utilizing a unified dual-stream and single-stream diffusion transformer. Generates high-definition (720p/1080p) cinema-grade video clips with physical dynamics.

name: CogVideoX
description: Open-source text-to-video diffusion transformer model developed by THUDM and Zhipu AI. Employs 3D Variational Autoencoders and expert transformer backends to produce coherent 6-second video clips up to 4K resolution.

name: Voyage-3
description: High-performance text embedding model engineered by Voyage AI delivering top retrieval accuracy on the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB). Optimized for domain-specific RAG pipelines across finance, code, and legal documents.

name: Cohere Embed v3
description: Cohere's enterprise embedding model family supporting 100+ languages and multimodal image-text searches. Outperforms previous generations in noisy document retrieval using compression-aware quantization embeddings.

name: XTTS-v2
description: Deep learning text-to-speech foundation model from Coqui capable of realistic voice cloning across 17 languages from a 3-second audio reference sample without extensive speaker fine-tuning.

name: Mistral NeMo
description: 12-billion parameter multilingual foundation model co-developed by Mistral AI and NVIDIA. Features a 128K context window and the Tekken tokenizer for efficient multilingual inference and code synthesis.

name: Jina Embeddings v3
description: Open-source 570M parameter embedding model supporting 8192-token context lengths across 89 languages. Uses task-specific LoRA adapters to optimize vectors for retrieval, classification, clustering, and semantic matching.

name: Gemini 1.5 Flash
description: Google DeepMind's lightweight, low-latency multimodal foundation model. Optimized for high-frequency tasks, cost efficiency, and massive 1-million-token context processing across text, audio, images, and video feeds.

name: GPT-4o mini
description: OpenAI's cost-efficient small multimodal model replacing GPT-3.5 Turbo. Supports text and vision inputs with a 128K context window, scoring strongly on reasoning, coding, and mathematical benchmarks at a fraction of flagship model costs.

name: Qwen2.5-Coder
description: Code-specialized open-weight model series from Alibaba Cloud ranging from 0.5B to 32B parameters. Trained on 5.5 trillion tokens of source code, technical documentation, and synthetic coding datasets with a 128K context window.

name: Qwen2-VL
description: Vision-language model family from Alibaba (2B, 7B, 72B) featuring NaViT dynamic image resolution architecture. Accurately reads arbitrary aspect-ratio images, interprets fine document text, and parses video events with second-level grounding.

name: DeepSeek-Coder-V2
description: Open-source Mixture-of-Experts language model for code and mathematics supporting 338 programming languages and a 128K context window. Available in 16B (2.4B active) and 236B (21B active) parameter scales.

name: Pixtral 12B
description: 12-billion parameter multimodal language model trained by Mistral AI. Integrates a custom 400M parameter vision encoder to natively reason over arbitrary images, documents, and technical charts alongside natural text across a 128K context window.

name: FLUX.1 [dev]
description: 12-billion parameter open-weight rectified flow transformer model from Black Forest Labs. Delivers state-of-the-art text-to-image quality, photorealistic skin textures, accurate multi-word typography, and detailed prompt comprehension.

name: Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL)
description: Stability AI's flagship 3.5-billion parameter latent diffusion model engineered for native 1024x1024 resolution image generation. Uses a base model followed by an ensemble refiner model to render intricate backgrounds and realistic lighting.

name: Kolors
description: Open-source text-to-image diffusion model developed by Kuaishou's Kolors Team. Built with the ChatGLM language model as its text encoder to achieve nuanced bilingual understanding (Chinese and English) and high-quality typography rendering.

name: Bark
description: Transformer-based text-to-audio foundation model created by Suno. Generates realistic multilingual speech, non-verbal vocalizations (laughter, sighs, clearing throat), background ambient sounds, and basic music from text prompts.

name: Whisper large-v3-turbo
description: Fine-tuned, pruned variant of OpenAI's Whisper large-v3 model. Reduces the number of decoder layers from 32 to 4 to deliver an 8x speedup in multilingual audio transcription and translation with minimal loss in accuracy.

name: BGE Reranker-v2
description: Multilingual cross-encoder reranking model series (m3 and gemma variants) developed by the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence. Computes deep relevance scores between queries and retrieved passages to dramatically boost RAG precision.

name: Cohere Rerank 3
description: Enterprise cross-encoder foundation model from Cohere engineered for semantic reranking of search results across 100+ languages, semi-structured JSON objects, emails, code snippets, and noisy web documents.

name: InternVL 2.0
description: Open-source multimodal foundation model family developed by OpenGVLab ranging from 1B to 108B parameters. Achieves top scores in multimodal benchmarks, chart understanding, OCR, document analysis, and video grounding.

name: Molmo 72B
description: Open multimodal vision-language model developed by the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2). Outperforms proprietary models on academic benchmarks using open datasets and transparent human-collected visual pointing annotations.

name: Moondream2
description: Compact 1.6-billion parameter vision-language model engineered to run locally on edge hardware, mobile phones, and Raspberry Pi devices. Capable of visual question answering, image captioning, and object detection.
